body.statement: On \(G_{\mathrm{kill}}=a-c-b\) with \(K=2\), \(\Sigma=\operatorname{diag}(1,0,1)\), and \(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{kill}}\), a join state with bag label \(\lambda(c)=2\) rejects the two children that have each completed absent label \(1\). The analogous local join with label \(1\) active on the separator \(c\) accepts the transitive-closure merge of the two label-\(1\) components.
body.justification: The width-one witness isolates the exact join error that would falsely certify a disconnected cluster.
body.gap: The generic prose correctness argument in Casel et al. does not state the completed-label flag invariant needed when part sizes are not prescribed.
body.consumer: It is a minimal unit certificate for implementations and for the soundness induction at join nodes.
